Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggered the bug by calling the `showBug()` method, which in turn calls the `configure()` method of the `SpringApplicationBuilder` class. The `configure()` method is annotated with the `@ComponentScan` annotation, which causes the `SpringApplicationBuilder` to scan the entire classpath and load all the Spring components. This slows down the startup of the application and may cause a `BeanDefinitionStoreException` if the Spring Framework package is scanned.
